question: Who among the following has written the novel "The Awasthis of Aamnagri'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Shubha Sharma.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **IAS Officer Shubha Sarma's** second book,** "The Awasthis of Aamnagri,"** was published by Niyogi Books in 2020.
 
• **"Fly on the Wall and Other Stories"** is her first book.

** __** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

 
• Recent books of **Chetan Bhagat **are **"400 Days"** and **"One arranged Murder"**.
 
• **Debashish Panigrahi**, Senior IPS officer and Director Vigilance of Odisha Police, is the author of the book **"Things Left Unsaid."**
 
• **Sarabjit Singh Attwal **was an **Indian national** who was convicted by a Pakistani court of terrorism and spying.
 
• A book was written on his life, **"Sarabjit Singh: A Case of Mistaken Identity" **by** Awais Sheikh.**
